  • Method Details

    • install

      @Implementation protected static HttpResponseCache install(File directory, long maxSize)
      Installs the cache the way the framework does, by making it the default ResponseCache.

      Keeping it anywhere else would leave ResponseCache.getDefault() empty, which callers reach through the inherited HttpResponseCache.getDefault().

    • reset

      @Resetter public static void reset()
      The default ResponseCache is process-wide state that outlives the sandbox, so a cache a test installs has to be uninstalled again. Anything else installed there is left alone.
